channel.title: Change materials faster with the new Material Picker [Beta]
channel.description:
### [Update] April 26, 2024 [quote=“Bogden, post:62, topic:2945587, full:true”] Hi everyone, Thanks for your patience! We've re-enabled the beta for additional testing. If you were experiencing an issue where the feature appeared disabled even after enabling the beta, please try the following to re-enable the feature: 1. Disable the Material Picker beta. 2. Restart Studio. 3. Enable the Material Picker beta. [/quote] --- ### [Update] April 25, 2024 [quote=“Bogden, post:47, topic:2945587, full:true”] Hi everyone, Unfortunately, we are disabling this beta for now to investigate technical issues. We apologize for the inconvenience and will keep you updated on when this is re-enabled. Thank you for your understanding and patience. [/quote] --- Hi Creators! We're excited to announce the beta release of **Material Picker**, which allows you to access materials directly from the ribbon. You can select from visual previews, search, and filter to find the right material, then apply it to parts without changing Studio’s layout. You can access Material Manager and Material Generator from the Material Picker, as they are now removed from the Home and Model tabs in the ribbon. ### How It Works ![RobloxStudioBeta_CS8CSmVwCe|video](upload://rQRXCtr0vXtWSUv1O8a2M3kGmJF.mp4) The Material Picker sits alongside the Color Picker in the ribbon on the home and model tabs, and works in a similar way.
![image1|690x481, 75%](upload://zZjOmNWKoLfDCfBHrAgnEgkeUKh.png)
Material Generator is a separate beta feature. Please refer to [this post for more information](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/material-generator-beta/2224446). The Material Picker also works with MaterialVariants. Now you can load in a custom material pack, and quickly hover over the materials to preview them. *(Updated on April 25, 2024 to call out a feature.)* ### How To Enable The Beta Go to **File > Beta Features,** and enable **Material Picker**.
![image2|499x500, 85%](upload://egKtku7F65lTHbQAKQ4ShG6yf6V.png)
### What's Next We’re planning to integrate Material Picker with the Properties Panel to make material selection easy from everywhere. We look forward to your feedback! Warm regards, The Studio Builder Tools Team 🛠️

The update is good, but there are some annoying moments:

  • Constant freezing when opening due to the fact that the top panel is hidden by default, and when I want to select a new object, this panel closes again, and I have to reopen it (Demonstrated in the video). (I don’t like to keep the panel open as I value my screen space).
